captions.detailed: A benchtop monocular laboratory microscope consisting of a heavy, rounded light-gray base supporting a vertical square column and a fixed black specimen stage. A light-gray optical body carriage is mounted on the column, supporting an angled cylindrical eyepiece tube and a boxy nosepiece/objective turret. The optical body carriage can slide vertically along the column for focusing, and a pair of black, circular focus knobs are mounted on the sides of the carriage to rotate continuously about their shared horizontal axis.
